title: Verify workspace.create-file Skill through the real M8 chat path
goal: Prove that an explicit user file-creation request selects the declared workspace Skill, writes only inside the enabled workspace, and returns success only after read-back verification.
context: The M8 composition has a workspace.create-file manifest and a ModuleRuntime-backed executor. Integration coverage now checks both real file creation when enabled and fail-closed Skill scope when workspace tools are disabled.
forbidden_changes: Do not bypass Skill scope, ModuleRuntime policy, workspace path validation, or read-back verification.
Do not enable workspace tools by default.
Do not change provider/GGUF or unrelated UI behavior.
acceptance_criteria: With workspaceToolsEnabled=true, a Vietnamese explicit file request is selected as workspace.create-file in M8.
The requested workspace file exists and contains exactly the requested content.
The canonical Agent observation reports succeeded=true and verified=true only after real write/read-back.
With workspace tools disabled, workspace.create-file remains outside the allowed Skill scope.
M3, Agent Task Contract, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass.
verification: Confirm M3, Agent Task Contract, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA CI gates.
recovery: If the end-to-end test exposes a failure, fix the narrow root cause in this same logical task and retain the regression test; do not report success without green required gates.
